She mentions the setbacks they've faced and brings up the opening night of the play as a conflict. Henry says Arnold is returning and that Max has already arranged it. Julie responds with disbelief, clearly skeptical of Max's involvement. She questions how anything can work when Henry is leaving. As Henry steps closer and says he wants them to be together, Julie laughs, dismissing the idea. She reminds him they only had a brief affair and tells him she doesn’t want to be with him. Calling him a thief, she tells him to go rob his bank. Henry stands silent for a moment, then turns and leaves.
related_events: Julie expresses frustration about recurring setbacks
Julie confronts Henry about his departure and the play
Henry reveals Arnold's return and Max's involvement

name: Henry Pleads for a Future, Julie Sends Him Away
description: Julie sits at her vanity, finishing her makeup, when there's a knock at the door. She tells the person to come in, and Henry appears. He tells her he wants her to meet him in California. She resists, saying they've already discussed this, but he insists they go tonight—it's the only time they can get into the vault. She scoffs, realizing it's opening night of the play. He argues it doesn't matter if it's tonight or later, he still wants her with him. She points out that everything is falling apart—his plans, his departure, the play. He says nothing is ruined, especially since Arnold is returning, as Max has already arranged. He moves closer and tells her he wants them to be together. She laughs, calling it ridiculous. She reminds him they only slept together a few times and says she doesn't want to be with him. She calls him a thief and tells him to go rob his bank. He stands silently for a moment, then turns and leaves.
related_events: Henry declares his desire to be with Julie
Julie dismisses her relationship with Henry as insignificant
Julie accuses Henry of being a thief and tells him to leave
Henry leaves after being rejected by Julie

name: Frank Proposes the Heist and Confronts Joe's Doubt
description: Frank sits in the back seat next to Henry as Joe drives and Max rides shotgun. He begins by asking what the others are thinking, then reveals the I.C.R.E.—Indigenous Currency Retrieval and Exchange—operation, explaining that once a month, a truck collects currency from partner banks across the Canadian border. He says the money, between eight and twelve million dollars, passes through the First Buffalo bank vault and stays there only a few hours before being redistributed. He leans in and says only fools would attempt a robbery at any other time. He offers the exact date of the next transfer, promises help with the alarms, and positions himself as the inside man. Max responds cautiously, pretending the idea of a heist is hypothetical, and asks why Frank would betray his own bank. Frank doesn’t answer at first. Then, when Joe mutters that it sounds like a setup, Frank suddenly reaches over and grabs him, locking eyes. He tells Joe he doesn’t play around and that he has his reasons. Max presses for an explanation. Frank says his wife got sick years ago and the insurance didn’t cover everything. He went to the bank for help, but they refused. They had planned to retire to the Loire Valley, but ended up spending all their savings on medical bills. His wife, Annie, died. He spent thirty years at the bank. The others are silent. Frank then gives them the date: November 23rd. The money arrives at eight and leaves at midnight. He tells Henry he’s retiring in two weeks. This will be his last act. He says, 'You set up the table. I make sure dinner arrives hot.'
related_events: Frank reveals details about the I.C.R.E. currency transport operation
Frank offers to assist in robbing First Buffalo bank
Frank physically grabs Joe and asserts his seriousness

name: Max Questions Frank's Motives
description: Max turns to Frank and asks why he would help them rob his own bank, making it clear he doesn’t believe him. Frank hesitates, then tells them his wife got sick years ago and the medical costs drained their savings. The insurance didn’t cover everything, and the bank refused to help. He says he spent thirty years working there, only to lose it all. Her name was Annie, he says. She died. The car falls silent. Frank then tells them the money will be at First Buffalo on November 23rd, arriving at eight and leaving at midnight. He adds that he retires in two weeks and this will be his last act.
related_events: Max questions Frank's motive for helping rob the bank
Frank reveals his personal motivation for robbing the bank

name: Frank Reveals the Heist Date and His Final Plan
description: Frank tells the others about the money transfer scheduled for November 23rd, when eight to twelve million dollars will be held at First Buffalo Bank for just a few hours. He gives the details: the delivery arrives at eight in the morning and is picked up at midnight. He says he can help with the alarms and be their inside man. Joe and Max question why he would betray his bank, and Frank responds by telling them about his wife Annie, who fell ill years ago. He explains that the insurance didn’t cover all her medical costs and the bank refused to help, forcing them to spend their life savings. She died soon after. Henry asks her name, and when Frank says it was Annie, Henry offers his sympathy. Frank then states he’s retiring in two weeks and this is his last chance. He tells them to set up the plan, and he’ll make sure everything goes smoothly when the time comes.
related_events: Frank discloses the schedule of the money delivery
Frank announces his retirement and final involvement
Henry expresses sympathy for Frank's loss

name: Frank Sets the Roles for the Heist
description: Frank tells Henry to set up the table and says he will make sure dinner arrives hot. He gives the date—November 23rd—when the money will be at First Buffalo, arriving at eight and leaving at midnight. He adds that he retires in two weeks, and this will be his last act.
related_events: Frank assigns roles for the heist preparation

name: Henry Joins the Dig
description: Henry enters the tunnel and immediately picks up a shovel, digging hard and fast. Max, noticing his intensity, asks if he's okay. Henry stops and turns, saying he's not leaving the girl. Max throws down his shovel and tells him to listen: they are digging the tunnel, robbing the bank, taking the money, and driving away. He insists that the job is one thing, and Julie is another—they are not the same. Joe calls out that he's found something, digging furiously at the ceiling. The dirt collapses, burying him briefly, revealing a smooth concrete surface underneath. Max looks up and says they've arrived.
related_events: Henry enters tunnel and begins digging
Max confronts Henry about his emotional state
Henry declares he is not leaving the girl
Max explains separation between bank robbery and Julie

name: Joe's Digging Reveals the Vault
description: Joe drives his shovel into the packed dirt of the tunnel ceiling. The earth gives way suddenly, collapsing onto him in a cloud of dust and debris. Buried beneath the fallen soil, he thrashes and gasps, clawing his way free. He stumbles to his feet, dazed and covered in dirt. Above, where the tunnel roof had been, a smooth slab of concrete is now exposed. Max looks up, takes it in, and grins. "We have arrived!" he says, staring at the underside of the bank vault floor.
related_events: Joe digs through dirt and triggers collapse above him
Tunnel ceiling collapses and reveals concrete vault floor
Joe struggles and recovers from being buried
Max announces arrival upon seeing vault floor

name: Max and Joe Dig the Tunnel
description: Max and Joe dig steadily through the earth, shovel after shovel, their bodies coated in dirt and sweat from hours of labor. The tunnel stretches behind them, a narrow passage carved by their effort. The air is thick with dust, and their movements grow heavy, but they keep digging, breaking through the dark soil in silence. The walls hold firm around them as they push deeper, the sound of scraping earth filling the cramped space.
related_events: Max and Joe dig tunnel for hours

name: Hooded Figures Appear on Stage
description: The stage lights rise, revealing a line of hooded, faceless figures standing behind a scrim, each with an axe at their side. The figures step forward, walking out onto the stage.
related_events: Lights reveal hooded faceless figures on stage
Hooded figures walk out onto the stage

name: Lophakin Arrives Late, Yasha Reacts
description: Lophakin rushes onto the stage, breathing heavily from his hurried entrance. Yasha, holding a tray of champagne glasses, turns to look at him with a clear expression of disapproval.
related_events: Lophakin rushes onto the stage
Yasha gives disapproving look to Lophakin

name: Madame Ranevsky Gives Money to the Hooded Figures
description: Madame Ranevsky approaches the line of hooded figures standing behind the scrim and hands out cash from her purse. Gayev watches and speaks to her, saying she gave away everything and that it was wrong. She replies that she couldn't help it. Without acknowledging Lophakin, who has just arrived, Gayev and Madame Ranevsky walk off the stage in opposite directions.
related_events: Madame Ranevsky distributes money to hooded figures
Gayev criticizes Madame Ranevsky's generosity

name: Yasha Dismisses Peasants as Gayev and Madame Ranevsky Ignore Lophakin
description: Yasha stands with a tray of champagne glasses and remarks that the peasants are good fellows but a little stupid. Nearby, Gayev and Madame Ranevsky pass by Lophakin without speaking to him or acknowledging his presence, continuing on their way off the stage.
related_events: Yasha comments on peasants' intelligence
Gayev and Madame Ranevsky walk past Lophakin while ignoring him

name: Lophakin Offers Champagne Before Farewell
description: Still a little out of breath, Lophakin calls out, asking someone to come and drink a glass of champagne as a farewell. The others ignore him as they walk past, leaving him standing alone on stage.
related_events: Lophakin invites someone to drink a glass as a good-bye

name: Henry and Max Talk About Julie
description: Henry sits across from Max at the table as Max eats his cheerios. Henry says he asked Julie to meet him after they were done, but she said no. Max replies that of course she said no, because life always demands a price. He says the piper must be paid to pipe. Henry insists he’s already paid, and says he doesn’t want to leave her. Max looks at him, about to respond, when there’s a knock at the door.
related_events: Henry expresses regret over Julie rejecting his meeting request
Max delivers philosophical reflection on life's inevitable costs

name: Henry Answers the Door to Joe and Eddie
description: A knock at the door interrupts Max and Henry at the table. Henry gets up and asks who's there. Joe's voice comes from the other side, saying it's him. Henry opens the door to find Joe, clearly drunk and looking sheepish, standing beside Eddie Vibes. Without waiting, Eddie steps inside. Joe mutters an apology to Henry, then lies down on the floor. Eddie takes a seat, looks around, and says he knows about the vault job and wants in—either he joins, or Max is out. Max tells him Joe is drunk and doesn't know what he's saying, demanding Eddie get out of his chair. Eddie laughs, leans back, and says he and Henry go way back since high school. Henry confirms it. Eddie praises Henry for staying quiet, then says he just wants the American dream. Later, Max and Henry watch from the window as Eddie gets into his car. Eddie turns, sees them, and gives a thumbs-up before driving away.
related_events: Henry hears a knock at the door and investigates
Joe arrives at the door accompanied by Eddie Vibes

name: Eddie Vibes Takes Over
description: Eddie Vibes walks into the room without waiting for an invitation, steps inside, and takes a seat. He announces that he is the new partner. He tells Max that either he joins in, or Max is out. Joe lies on the floor, drunk and apologetic. Eddie leans back in the chair, unfazed, and asks for a cold drink. Max protests, saying Joe doesn’t know what he’s talking about and demands Eddie leave his seat. Eddie ignores him, calls Max 'old man,' and says he and Henry go way back. Henry confirms they knew each other in high school. Eddie thanks him for staying quiet and says he admires loyalty. When Henry asks what Eddie wants, Eddie replies, 'Nothing. Just the American dream.' Later, Max and Henry watch from the window as Eddie gets into his car. Eddie turns, notices them, and gives a thumbs-up before driving away.
related_events: Eddie Vibes enters the room without invitation
Eddie declares himself as the new partner

name: Max Demands Eddie Leave, Henry Questions His Intentions
description: Max glares at Eddie and tells him to get out of Joe's chair. Eddie laughs, leans back, and refuses to move. Henry asks Eddie what he wants. Eddie says he and Henry go way back, mentioning they knew each other since high school. Henry confirms it's true. Eddie thanks him for staying quiet, praising loyalty. Henry presses again, asking what Eddie really wants. Eddie smiles and says he just wants the American dream.
related_events: Max confronts Eddie and demands he leave Joe's chair
Henry questions Eddie's intentions
Eddie asserts his past connection with Henry from high school
Eddie states he only wants the American dream

name: Max and Henry Watch Eddie Drive Away
description: After Eddie walks out, Max and Henry move to the window and watch him approach his car. He gets inside, then turns and looks up, noticing them. With a smirk, he gives a thumbs-up before driving off.
related_events: Max and Henry watch Eddie leave from the window
Eddie gives a thumbs-up while leaving

name: The Green Room Before the Show
description: The cast stands in the green room, dressed in their stage attire, murmuring nervously among themselves. Henry lingers on one side of the room, while Julie stays on the opposite side, neither looking at the other. Their silence and distance cut through the scattered conversations, adding to the unease that hums beneath the chatter.
related_events: cast members chat nervously in the green room
Henry and Julie avoid each other in the green room
related_occasions: Rehearsal Gathering In The Green Room

name: Darek's Speech in the Green Room
description: Darek walks into the green room, and the chatter stops. The cast turns toward him as he begins to speak. He talks about the illusion of the American dream, how people pretend everything is fine while life keeps changing in painful, unpredictable ways. He describes the play as an exploration of misery, disconnection, and a future that arrives suddenly, like a speeding train. When he finishes, he leaves the room. The cast remains silent for a moment, then breaks into applause. Gayev laughs and calls out, 'Off the cushion in the corner; double into the centre pocket!' The group laughs. Simon calls, 'Ten minutes people!'
related_events: Darek enters the green room and commands attention
Darek speaks about the illusion of the American dream
Darek frames the play as an exploration of misery, disconnection, and an unforeseen future
related_occasions: Rehearsal Gathering In The Green Room

name: Darek's Speech in the Green Room
description: Darek stood before the cast in the green room, his voice steady and intense. After speaking about the illusion of the American dream and the relentless force of change, he declared that the play would show the audience the future was not something to fear. The room, once filled with nervous chatter, fell into a charged silence. The performers exchanged glances, their posture shifting as a new energy took hold. Moments later, they burst into applause. Gayev laughed and called out a playful line that broke the tension, and Simon announced, 'Ten minutes people!', prompting the group to begin preparing for the performance.
related_events: Darek declares the future is not something to fear
Darek's speech shifts the mood to focused anticipation
related_occasions: Rehearsal Gathering In The Green Room

name: Cast Applauds After Darek's Speech
description: After Darek left the green room, a heavy silence lingered for a moment. Then the cast broke into applause, their voices and clapping filling the space. Gayev laughed and called out, 'Off the cushion in the corner; double into the centre pocket!', drawing chuckles and easing the tension. Simon raised his voice and announced, 'Ten minutes people!', and the group began preparing for the performance.
related_events: Darek exits the green room after his speech
Cast members erupt into applause after Darek's speech
related_occasions: Rehearsal Gathering In The Green Room

name: Gayev's Joke and Simon's Countdown
description: After Darek left the room, a charged silence lingered. Gayev broke it with a grin, calling out, 'Off the cushion in the corner; double into the centre pocket!' The cast burst into laughter, shoulders relaxing, the tension dissolving into shared amusement. Moments later, Simon raised his voice over the chatter, 'Ten minutes people!' The laughter faded, replaced by the rustle of costumes adjusting and quiet murmurs as the cast began moving toward the stage.
related_events: Gayev exclaims a humorous line that breaks the tension
Simon announces ten minutes until performance
related_occasions: Rehearsal Gathering In The Green Room

name: Madame Ranevskaya Confronts Henry During Rehearsal
description: Madame Ranevskaya, still agitated from her argument with Trofimov, turns her attention to Henry, who stands in the stalls wearing period costume and a beard. Their eyes meet across the space. She tells him sharply that at twenty-six or twenty-seven, he should be grown up by now, that he ought to understand about love. Her voice carries intensity as she insists he should love someone, that he should have an affair. Henry remains silent, absorbing her words as the rehearsal continues around them.
related_events: Madame Ranevskaya confronts Henry about emotional maturity

name: Trofimov Accuses, Madame Ranevskaya Denies
description: During the dress rehearsal, Trofimov speaks sharply to Madame Ranevskaya, telling her the man has robbed her and calling him a scoundrel known for exploitation. She covers her ears, shouting 'No! No! No!' and refusing to listen. The exchange unfolds in front of the others, with Henry watching from the stalls, and Julie catching sight of him from the stage before walking off.
related_events: Trofimov accuses a man of robbing Madame Ranevskaya
Madame Ranevskaya refuses to hear accusation

name: Madame Ranevskaya Confronts Trofimov About His Studies
description: During the dress rehearsal, Madame Ranevskaya turns to Trofimov and tells him he is twenty-six or twenty-seven and still in the lower grades. She insists he should be grown up by now and ought to understand about love. Trofimov responds with indifference, asking who cares. She raises her voice, insisting he should love someone, that he should have an affair. As she speaks, her gaze shifts and locks onto Henry, who stands in the stalls, bearded and in period costume, watching silently.
related_events: Madame Ranevskaya criticizes Trofimov for not advancing academically

name: Henry Confronts Julie After Rehearsal
description: Henry sits in the stalls, watching the dress rehearsal. On stage, Julie sees him and steps down, knowing he is waiting. As she walks off, he approaches her. 'What happened last night?' he asks. 'I came to my senses,' she replies. 'And you should too.' He tells her they should talk about it. She turns to face him. 'I don't want to, Henry.' Behind them, Darek claps his hands. 'Let's run the magic scene!'
related_events: Henry observes dress rehearsal from the stalls
Julie notices Henry from the stage
Julie exits the stage knowing Henry is waiting
Henry asks Julie about what happened the previous night
Julie tells Henry she came to her senses and urges him to do the same
Henry suggests they should talk about the previous night
Julie refuses to discuss the matter with Henry
Darek signals to begin the magic scene with a clap

name: Darek Searches for Djula During Rehearsal
description: During the dress rehearsal, Darek suddenly interrupts the scene, calling out urgently for Djula. His voice rises with distress as he asks where she is, breaking the rhythm of the performance. The others pause as his concern fills the room, drawing attention away from the rehearsal and toward his search.
related_events: Darek calls out for Djula in distress

name: Madame Ranevskaya Urges Darek to Love
description: During the dress rehearsal, Madame Ranevskaya turns to Darek with intensity. 'You ought to love someone yourself! You ought to have an affair. Yes! Yes!' she exclaims, her voice charged. Darek responds quietly, 'Yes. Yes. Good Djula.' A moment later, he claps his hands and calls for the magic scene to begin.
related_events: Madame Ranevskaya urges Darek to experience love and have an affair

name: Eddie Takes Control with a Gun
description: After the duffels of cash are lined up by the door, Eddie stands silently with a gun pointed at Max and Joe. Max asks what the gun is for, and Eddie replies it's a gun. He turns to Joe and orders him to take the money out back to his car. Joe doesn't move. Eddie waves the gun and repeats the order. When Joe still hesitates, Eddie shouts at him again, demanding he take the money to the car and telling him to shut up.
related_events: Eddie points gun at Max and Joe after counting money
Eddie orders Joe to take money to his car
Eddie orders Joe to put money in the car while silencing him

name: Max Stands Against Eddie
description: Max steps in front of the gun, blocking Joe from moving. Eddie presses the gun to Max's stomach. Max doesn't back down, speaking directly to Eddie, accusing him of making the same mistake again, of failing. Eddie punches Max in the gut and hits him in the head, sending him backward. Max ends up on the floor with a gash on his forehead. Eddie kicks him again after Max continues to confront him.
related_events: Max confronts Eddie and blocks Joe from moving
Eddie places gun against Max's stomach
Eddie punches Max in the gut and strikes his head
Eddie kicks Max after being confronted about his failure

name: Eddie Attacks Max and Confronts Henry
description: Max stands his ground as Eddie points a gun at him and Joe. Eddie punches Max in the gut and hits him in the head, knocking him to the floor with a gash on his forehead. Joe hesitates when ordered to take the money to the car. The door opens and Henry steps in, freezing when he sees the gun. Eddie greets him sarcastically, keeping the weapon in hand as the standoff continues.
related_events: Eddie punches Max in the gut and strikes his head
Eddie greets Henry with sarcasm amid armed standoff

name: Henry Interrupts the Standoff
description: The door swings open and Henry walks in, stopping short when he sees Eddie holding a gun. Eddie turns toward him and says, 'Welcome to the party, Brando.' The room falls tense as Henry stands frozen in the doorway, taking in the scene—Max on the floor with a gash on his forehead, Joe nearby, and Eddie in the center with the weapon in hand.
related_events: Henry enters and interrupts the confrontation
Henry freezes upon seeing Eddie with a gun
Eddie greets Henry with sarcasm amid armed standoff

name: Joe and Max Subdue Eddie
description: Joe lunges from behind and grabs Eddie's gun hand. The gun goes off as they struggle. Joe bites down on Eddie's hand, wrenching it tighter. Max rushes in, straddling Eddie and slamming his head against the ground. Together, they overpower him.
related_events: Joe intervenes by grabbing Eddie's gun hand from behind
Gun discharges during struggle between Joe and Eddie
Joe bites Eddie's hand during the weapon struggle
Max attacks Eddie by slamming his head into the ground

name: Joe and Henry Restrain Eddie
description: After the struggle, Henry picks up the gun from the ground. Joe tells him to get an extension cord. Henry returns with it, and together they roll Eddie over, tying his hands and then his legs with the cord. Eddie thrashes and shouts through a glove stuffed in his mouth, yelling that they couldn’t have taken him down without him. Max watches, then notices Henry’s thigh. There’s a graze. Henry looks down, sees the blood, and hears the tannoy calling him. He’s late. Without a word, he gets up and rushes out the door.
related_events: Henry retrieves the gun after recovering from shock
Joe instructs Henry to get the extension cord
Joe and Henry restrain Eddie with an extension cord
Eddie protests that Joe and Max couldn't have succeeded without him

name: Max Gags Eddie After Takedown
description: With Eddie pinned to the ground, Max straddled him and mocked him, calling him their new partner. He then stuffed a glove into Eddie's mouth to silence him. Eddie thrashed and kicked, but remained bound.
related_events: Max mocks Eddie as their new partner and gags him with a glove

name: Henry Notices the Graze and Rushes to the Stage
description: Max looked at Henry's leg and saw the injury. He asked if Henry was okay. Henry looked down and saw the graze on his thigh, blood streaking the fabric. He realized he had been hit when the gun went off. The tannoy sounded again, calling him to the stage. He remembered he was late. Without a word, he turned and ran out the door toward the theater.
related_events: Max notices Henry's leg injury from the gunshot graze
Henry realizes he has been grazed by a bullet
Henry remembers he is late for his performance and rushes to stage
